items.title: PipelineForge
items.description:
About: A web application designed to automate the creation of **CI/CD pipelines** for various platforms. It streamlines the workflow by replacing manual YAML writing with a modular interface.

Capabilities: Users can easily toggle essential jobs such as **security scanning, linting, and automated deployment**.

Core Logic: Powered by the **Jinja2** templating engine for flexible and dynamic configuration generation.

Deployment: The project is fully **containerized** and production-ready, utilizing **Docker Compose** for seamless orchestration.
items.architecture:
Frontend: Next.js 16 + TailwindCSS for responsive UI.

Backend: Python Django 5 + Django REST Framework for API. PostgreSQL as primary database for storing user configurations.

Caching and queues: Redis for template caching, Celery for async generation of complex configurations.

Templating: Jinja2 for generating pipeline configs for GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and other platforms.

Deployment: Docker + Docker Compose for isolating all services (frontend, backend, DB, Redis, Celery workers).

items.title: Support Platform
items.description:
Project Scope: Built a custom internal tool for a startup to streamline support workflows, including task distribution and automated performance-based payroll.

DevOps Focus: Beyond development, I focused on high availability and data integrity within the **AWS** ecosystem.

Data Protection: Implemented automated database backups to **AWS S3 buckets** to ensure disaster recovery readiness.

Observability: Set up **Prometheus and Grafana** for real-time infrastructure monitoring, tracking CPU, RAM, and storage health.

Alerting: Configured **Discord** notifications via webhooks for instant incident reporting, minimizing system downtime.

items.title: Uptime Monitor
items.description:
About: A specialized **Kotlin-based CLI** application built to track website availability in real-time.
